title: Americans Vote in Midterms That Will Shape Trump's Agenda
en: Americans headed to the polls on Tuesday in midterm elections that will decide control of Congress. All 435 seats in the House of Representatives and 35 of the 100 Senate seats are up for grabs. Opinion polls suggest Democrats are favored to win the House, while the Senate outcome remains uncertain. The results will shape the legislative agenda for the remaining two years of President Donald Trump's term, covering everything from tariffs to tax policy. Investors are watching closely, and markets this week are also awaiting Friday's October jobs report for fresh clues on the economy.
zh: 美国民众周二前往投票站，参加将决定国会控制权的中期选举。众议院全部435个席位和参议院100个席位中的35席都将展开角逐。民调显示民主党有望赢得众议院，而参议院结果仍存不确定性。选举结果将影响特朗普总统任期后两年的立法议程，涉及从关税到税收政策的方方面面。投资者正密切关注，本周市场还在等待周五公布的10月就业报告，以获取经济形势的新线索。

title: US Strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Mediators Race to Salvage Talks
en: Multiple explosions were heard on Iran's Qeshm Island overnight, and US officials described the strike as a limited, defensive operation aimed at missile systems near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they had captured two American MQM-170 reconnaissance drones, bringing the total to four. Tehran insists that Washington must first address seven conditions before it will reopen the strait to shipping. Qatar, which is mediating between the two sides, said it expects responses from both within 36 hours to a new proposal aimed at ending the conflict, though significant differences remain to be bridged.
zh: 伊朗格什姆岛夜间传出多次爆炸声，美国官员称此次打击是一次有限的防御性行动，目标是霍尔木兹海峡附近的导弹系统。伊朗革命卫队表示俘获了两架美军MQM-170侦察无人机，使俘获该型无人机总数达到4架。德黑兰坚持，美方必须先回应七项条件，才会重新向航运开放该海峡。担任斡旋方的卡塔尔表示，预计36小时内将收到双方对一份旨在结束冲突的新提案的回应，但仍有重大分歧有待弥合。

title: AMD Shares Surge as Data Center Revenue Nearly Doubles
en: AMD reported third-quarter revenue of 13.38 billion dollars, up 45 percent from a year earlier and ahead of expectations, while adjusted earnings reached 2.09 dollars a share. Data center revenue jumped 97 percent to 8.55 billion dollars, driven by demand for its AI processors, and now accounts for 64 percent of total sales. The company guided fourth-quarter revenue to about 17 billion dollars, well above analyst estimates of roughly 16.3 billion. Chief Executive Lisa Su said data center demand should accelerate further as new systems ramp up. The chipmaker's shares rose more than 9 percent in extended trading.
zh: AMD公布第三季度营收133.8亿美元，同比增长45%，超出市场预期；调整后每股收益达2.09美元。受AI处理器需求推动，数据中心业务收入跃升97%，至85.5亿美元，目前占总营收的64%。公司指引第四季度营收约170亿美元，远高于分析师约163亿美元的预期。首席执行官苏姿丰表示，随着新系统产能爬坡，数据中心需求将进一步加速。这家芯片制造商的股价盘后上涨超过9%。
vocab: 短语 提升产能；爬坡

title: Australia Lifts Rates to 4.85%, Highest Level Since 2008
en: The Reserve Bank of Australia lifted its cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85 percent, the highest level since 2008 and the fifth increase this year, making it one of the most aggressive central banks among advanced economies. Six board members voted for the hike while three preferred to hold, a sharper split than at September's meeting. Annual inflation was 4.3 percent in September, and the bank expects it to stay above 3 percent over the coming year, returning to the top of its target range only by late 2027. Policymakers also noted that AI-related investment is lifting technology goods prices.
zh: 澳大利亚储备银行将现金利率上调25个基点至4.85%，为2008年以来最高水平，也是今年第五次加息，使其成为发达经济体中立场最强硬的央行之一。六名理事会成员投票支持加息，三名主张维持不变，分歧较9月会议明显加大。9月年度通胀率为4.3%，该行预计未来一年通胀将持续高于3%，到2027年底才能回落至目标区间上沿。政策制定者还指出，与人工智能相关的投资正在推高科技类商品价格。

title: El Nino Reaches Record Strength, Chinese Forecasters Say
en: China's meteorological authorities said a super El Nino event formed over the equatorial central-eastern Pacific in September and developed into the strongest event since monitoring records began in October. It is expected to peak in late autumn or early winter and will significantly influence China's climate this winter and next spring. Forecasters predict overall warmer-than-normal temperatures across the country this winter, but slightly more frequent cold waves, with sharp temperature swings. Risks include heavy snow and strong cooling in northern regions, and periods of low-temperature rain, snow and freezing conditions in the south, the forecasters warned.
zh: 中国气象部门表示，9月赤道中东太平洋形成一次超强厄尔尼诺事件，10月已发展为有监测记录以来最强的一次。预计它将在秋末冬初达到峰值，并对中国今年冬季和明年春季的气候产生显著影响。预报人员预计，今冬全国气温总体偏高，但寒潮频次略偏多，气温冷暖起伏大。预报人员警告，风险包括北方地区的强降雪和剧烈降温，以及南方阶段性低温雨雪冰冻天气。

title: Trump Says Deal Reached to End 4 Billion Dollars in Annual Aid to Israel
en: US President Donald Trump said that he had reached an agreement with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to halt roughly 4 billion dollars in annual military aid to Israel. The announcement marks a striking shift in one of Washington's most consequential security relationships. Tensions between the two leaders have grown over strategy toward Iran and the wider region, with Netanyahu reported to have urged Trump to resume strikes on Iran after the midterm elections, while Trump has leaned toward negotiations with Tehran. The timing of the announcement, coming on the eve of the midterm elections, drew wide attention.
zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他已与以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡达成协议，将停止向以色列提供每年约40亿美元的军事援助。这一宣布标志着华盛顿最重要的安全关系之一发生显著转变。两位领导人在对伊朗及更广泛地区的战略问题上分歧日增，据报道内塔尼亚胡曾敦促特朗普在中期选举后恢复对伊朗的打击，而特朗普更倾向于与德黑兰谈判。这一声明选在中期选举前夕发布，引起广泛关注。
vocab: adj. 重要的；产生重大影响的
